quality.basis: 崩溃差分（fuzz harness 输入），判定端固定分配上限使分配失败可达；没有标准答案

ground_truth_evidence: category 5: none: the dataset's input never reaches the changed code (it OOMs libFuzzer while printing a string, a path the diff does not touch), and we do not ship an invented PoV; the injected NULL-check removal is reachable only when a print-buffer allocation fails.

review.note: a 500 MB input and libFuzzer out-of-memory

category5.design: The injected code removes the `ensure()==NULL` checks in print_value for the null/true/false/raw cases, so when the print buffer cannot grow those cases strcpy/memcpy through NULL. A failed allocation is unreachable under libFuzzer's defaults, so the judge fixes an ASan allocation cap (allocator_may_return_null=1:max_allocation_size_mb=16): then a print buffer grown past 16 MiB by such a literal returns NULL and the vulnerable build crashes while the secure build returns cleanly. No dataset input triggers this, so there is no ground truth.
